fr_html: M. ADATCI se rallie à l'opinion de Mr. Root qui est celle du bon sens. Il serait en effet dangereux de modifier la terminologie.
en_html: M. ADATCI agreed with Mr. Root: he thought his was the sensible point of view. Practically it would be dangerous to alter the terminology.
